Qingdao, CHINA ... 07139010 ... 9751798", "2026-02-16 ... Shanghai, CHINA ... 07139010 ... 9702720". Second slug (jai-bharat-gum-chemicals-ltd) shows US-side rows: "2022-05-14 | JAI BHARAT GUM & CHEMICALS LTD | TO ORDER | GUAR GUM REFINED SPLITS | Pipavab, India | Qingdao, China | 130002 | DEL30C173100" plus 2021-09-19 (DEL901479400), 2020-09-24 (DEL204472100), 2019-04-11 (DEL901979500), 2018-09-22 (DEL801478400). Top ports table: MUNDRA SEA 38, Qingdao 29, MUNDRA SEA INMUN1 19, Shanghai 9, Xingang China 9. Source counter: page claims 284 shipments / 7 trading partners / 14 ports; rows actually visible to me: 5 India-export rows on the main slug + 5 US-import rows on the second slug = 10 rows seen. Third slug variant (jai-bharat-gum-chemicals-limited) returned an empty record set.
domestic_evidence: No domestic supply record retrieved. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report domestic/export splits were not obtained: DuckDuckGo search backend returned "no results (searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>)" on all three queries, and volza.com returned "fetch_error: HTTP Error 403: Forbidden". No GSTIN, turnover figure or contract is asserted here — null, not public in sources reached.
note: Actual shipments are confirmed, not merely claimed: dated customs export lines with destination, HS code and bill-of-lading number exist for 2018-2026, with the most recent on 2026-02-25 (guar gum refined splits, Mundra -> Xingang, HS 07139010, B/L 9991721). Note the HS discrepancy: declared HS 130232 (guar gum and its derivatives) does not match the observed shipment codes — the export rows are classified 07139010 (dehulled guar splits, i.e. a legume/vegetable product) and one row 09083120 (cardamom). Per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection: the company stays in the base, the factual code should be corrected to 07139010 (with 09083120 as a secondary observed code), verdict accepted_hs_corrected with this caveat. The entity appears to operate multiple units (Siwani Mandi, Distt. Bhiwani, Haryana per ImportKey address; also Unit-II Village Dhani Ramjas, Siwani Mandi-127046; and the Chimique (India) Gujarat plant / powder division names in the input) — these are treated as one supplier group; the shipment records are registered under the Haryana entity. Domestic-side evidence is genuinely absent from the sources I could reach, so domestic_status is unknown rather than declared_only or none_found; the export record itself proves real supply activity, so this is not a 'no trace of supplies' case. Revenue and export volume figures: null — ImportKey shows shipment counts (284 claimed) but no values, and no financials were retrievable.
